availability_convention: Date keys: available_from <= setup session; source candle end < setup session, so information precedes setup open.
daily_rule: Global fixed trading-session buckets; available_from is the next bound session after a complete candle.
monthly_rule: Whole calendar month certified by the bound calendar; available_from is the next calendar month start.
unknown_rule: A NaN column value has NaT column availability and is never filled or converted to NO. Infinity and signed zero stay known.
clock_storage: One shared native row clock, explicitly referenced by every registered column; column reads mask it by that column known value.
